entities.summary: The Constitution of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea is the communist state constitution of North Korea. It was approved by the 6th Supreme People's Assembly at its first session on 27 December 1972, and has been amended and supplemented in 1992, 1998, 2009, 2010, 2012, 2013, 2016, 2019 (twice), 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026. It replaced the country's first constitution which was approved in 1948. Originally named the Socialist Constitution of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, it assumed its current name in March 2026.
